Description: Task-level metadata and HED annotations for task-meditation event tables. Designed for event files produced by merging EEG event markers with PsychToolbox text logs (*_info.txt; run_mw_experiment6.m): columns trial_index, txt_label, txt_onset_log_s, and merge_note document alignment between the EEG marker stream and the behavioral log. Each merged trial is an ordered experience-sampling probe sequence during seated concentration meditation: MW probe onset, meditation-depth rating, mind-wandering-depth rating, tiredness rating, then return to meditation. When tables use only core BIDS columns (no merged fields), optional columns below may be absent.

onset.Description: Event onset time relative to the first EEG sample of the continuous recording for this run.

duration.Description: Event duration. All events in this dataset are discrete markers, so this column is always n/a.

trial_type.Description: Semantic event category from the BIDS events table; complements value (raw trigger code) and txt_label (role within the probe sequence). Stimulus rows begin a mind-wandering (MW) experience-sampling probe trial (EEG trigger value 128); response rows are key presses (trigger values 1, 2, 4, or 8) following that stimulus within the same ordered trial block. Use txt_label to distinguish the ordered response type: key_status_1 = meditation-depth rating, key_status_2 = mind-wandering-depth rating, and key_status_3 = tiredness rating.

Levels.stimulus: Mind-wandering probe trial onset in EEG (marker 128 on parallel-port line 8); paired with MW_question times in the text log after clock alignment.
Levels.response: Key response to one ordered question within the MW probe sequence; order within the trial maps to text-log key lines by txt_label and merge_note.
Levels.STATUS: BioSemi acquisition system marker (value 254 in this dataset). Not generated by the PsychToolbox paradigm script.
Levels.unspecified_trial_type: Marker not classified as stimulus or response in the source export. In this dataset this is exclusively value 16, which is observed mid-recording in some BioSemi exports and is not generated by run_mw_experiment6.m; semantics are unknown (likely parallel-port artifact or hardware code) and rows should be excluded from analysis pending QC.

response_time.Description: Reserved BIDS column; always n/a in this dataset. Rating responses are conveyed by the EEG trigger code in value (and the per-key text-log line) rather than as a continuous response latency relative to the stimulus.

sample.Description: Zero-based sample index of the event relative to the first stored sample of the continuous recording, per the BIDS events spec. Within rounding it satisfies sample = round(onset * SamplingFrequency); e.g. onset 71.3867187500 s at 256 Hz = sample 18275.

value.Description: Integer event code on the BioSemi parallel-port marker channel (EEGLAB-style import). Per run_mw_experiment6.m (Delorme, 2014), key n in {0,1,2,3} is sent on parallel-port line n+1, producing trigger value 2^n: keys 0/1/2/3 -> trigger values 1/2/4/8. The MW probe is sent on parallel-port line 8, producing 128. Values 16 and 254 are not generated by the paradigm script; they originate from the BioSemi system marker stream.

Levels.1: EEG marker for key line 1 (key 0; rating value 0). Permitted by the paradigm code but not observed in any exported event table in this dataset.
Levels.2: EEG marker for key line 2 (key 1; rating value 1) within an MW probe response block.
Levels.4: EEG marker for key line 3 (key 2; rating value 2) within an MW probe response block.
Levels.8: EEG marker for key line 4 (key 3; rating value 3) within an MW probe response block.
Levels.16: Mid-recording marker observed in some BioSemi exports; not generated by run_mw_experiment6.m. Semantics unknown (likely parallel-port artifact or hardware code). Always paired with trial_type=unspecified_trial_type in this dataset.
Levels.128: MW probe stimulus trigger on parallel-port line 8 (primary trial anchor for aligning EEG blocks with MW_question lines in *_info.txt).
Levels.254: BioSemi acquisition status marker (typically a recording-start sentinel, high byte 0xFE on the trigger channel). Always paired with trial_type=STATUS in this dataset and not generated by the PsychToolbox script.

trial_index.Description: 1-based index of the MW experience-sampling probe trial within the run after pairing EEG stimulus blocks with behavioral-log trials. Rows sharing the same index belong to one ordered probe sequence (one stimulus plus up to three rating responses).

txt_label.Description: Ordered trial role relative to the PsychToolbox text log (same session *_info.txt). MW_question marks the probe onset; key_status_1, key_status_2, and key_status_3 identify the first, second, and third ordered rating responses within the probe sequence. The ordered response types are meditation depth, mind-wandering depth, and tiredness, respectively.

Levels.MW_question: Probe onset line in the text log reporting when the experience-sampling MW question sequence began (paired with EEG stimulus code 128 after EEG-minus-log offset estimation).
Levels.key_status_1: First ordered response in the probe sequence: rating of meditation depth for the immediately preceding interval (0 = not meditating at all; 3 = deep meditative state).
Levels.key_status_2: Second ordered response in the probe sequence: rating of mind-wandering depth for the immediately preceding interval (0 = not mind wandering at all; 3 = immersed in thoughts).
Levels.key_status_3: Third ordered response in the probe sequence: rating of tiredness/drowsiness for the immediately preceding interval (0 = not drowsy at all; 3 = very drowsy).
Levels.response_1: Legacy label equivalent to key_status_1 (meditation-depth rating).
Levels.response_2: Legacy label equivalent to key_status_2 (mind-wandering-depth rating).
Levels.response_3: Legacy label equivalent to key_status_3 (tiredness/drowsiness rating).

txt_onset_log_s.Description: Time in seconds from the PsychToolbox tic/toc clock for MW_question or key events as written to *_info.txt by run_mw_experiment6.m. Convert to EEG-clock seconds by adding the per-session EEG-minus-log offset (column trial_clock_offset_s in the full merged TSV). The merger script in tools/pdf-extraction selects this offset by trying offsets derived from each of the first up to 6 EEG stimulus times against the first text-log MW time and choosing the one that maximizes the count of pairs matched within 8 s; with no candidates it falls back to a constant default. Use merge_note to interpret per-row alignment quality.

merge_note.Description: Provenance of row alignment between EEG markers and the text log, written by the merger script in tools/pdf-extraction. Pairing is forward-only with a per-trial tolerance of 8 s after offset selection. Curated final events tables omit unpaired EEG-orphan rows (source=eeg_orphan) and omit the source/key_code_txt/status_txt/trial_clock_offset_s columns.

Levels.aligned_by_order: Response row matched to the corresponding text-log key line by sequence within the trial after stimulus pairing.
Levels.stimulus_value_128_is_MW_prompt_in_EEG: Stimulus row: EEG value 128 identifies the MW probe on parallel-port line 8 from run_mw_experiment6.m. Canonical stimulus label emitted by the merger.
Levels.txt_key0_present_in_eeg_rare: Text log reports key code 0 for this response index while the EEG stream still carries a response marker (flagged for manual QC).
Levels.eeg_response_without_txt_key_at_this_ind: EEG response present at this ordered slot but no matching key line in the text block.
Levels.no_matching_EEG_stimulus_for_this_MW_blo: Text-log MW probe block with no EEG stimulus 128 within tolerance; merger emits text-derived rows whose onset is mw_time + offset_guess (no EEG sample).
Levels.txt_key_without_eeg_trial_match: Text-log key row from a text-only block (companion rows to no_matching_EEG_stimulus_for_this_MW_block).
Levels.no_matching_MW_line_in_txt_for_this_128_: EEG stimulus 128 without a paired MW_question line (orphan stimulus; excluded from curated final events tables).
Levels.follows_unpaired_stimulus: Response rows following an EEG-only stimulus block with no text MW line (orphan block; retained only in non-curated intermediate merge outputs).

ExperimentalParadigm.Description: Probe-caught experience-sampling paradigm during seated concentration meditation, based on Brandmeyer and Delorme, Reduced mind wandering in experienced meditators and associated EEG correlates (DOI: 10.1007/s00221-016-4811-5; PMID: 27815577) and implemented in code/run_mw_experiment6.m (Arnaud Delorme, Jan 20 2014). The article describes a 45-90 minute experiment, at least 30 probes, and a 5-minute training block before the experiment; those values describe the published protocol and are not enforced by this script. The script as committed here uses expeDuration=1800 s (30 min single run), minDuration=150 s plus a uniform 0-15 s jitter between probes, probe mode (mode='p'), and BioSemi parallel-port triggers via the legacy MATLAB digitalio API. Audio prompts are PsychToolbox sound() playback of WAV files: voice_rate_med plays at probe onset (status 0->1), voice_rate_mw plays after the meditation-depth key (status 1->2), voice_rate_tired plays after the mind-wandering-depth key (status 2->3), and voice_resumemed plays after the tiredness key (status 3->0).

OrderedTrialTypes.Prompt: Begin ordered self-report sequence for the same immediately preceding meditation interval.
Please rate the depth of your meditation.
OrderedTrialTypes.Scale: 0 = not meditating at all; 3 = deep meditative state.

OrderedTrialTypes.Prompt: Please rate the depth of your mind wandering.
OrderedTrialTypes.Scale: 0 = not mind wandering at all; 3 = immersed in thoughts.

OrderedTrialTypes.Prompt: Please rate how tired you are.
OrderedTrialTypes.Scale: 0 = not drowsy at all; 3 = very drowsy.

ExperimentalParadigm.ResponseScale: Behavioral key values 0-3 are written to the text log; EEG response triggers in the curated events table are parallel-port marker values 1/2/4/8 (= 2^key) and should be interpreted with txt_label for ordered question identity. All three ratings refer to the same time interval immediately preceding the probe.
ExperimentalParadigm.ReturnToTask: After the ordered ratings, the paradigm plays voice_resumemed ("You may now resume your meditation") and resets status to 0.

StimulusPresentation.SoftwareVersion: n/a (not recorded; see run_mw_experiment6.m, Arnaud Delorme, Jan 20 2014)
StimulusPresentation.Description: MW probes and key responses logged to *_info.txt via PsychToolbox tic/toc/KbCheck/sound; EEG triggers sent on BioSemi parallel-port lines 1-4 (key values 2^n) and line 8 (MW probe = 128) via the legacy MATLAB digitalio API in run_mw_experiment6.m.
